title: DRep voting delegation introduced in Daedalus 7.0.0

summary.text: The official 7.0.0 release states that users can delegate voting power to DReps or select abstain or no confidence.

problem.text: A user needs to know whether the DRep voting-delegation controls described by the release exist in Daedalus 7.0.0.

symptoms.text: The user is looking for the voting tab and DRep registration preference in Daedalus 7.0.0.

daedalus.notes: The release proves functionality in 7.0.0 and its introduction there; this entry makes no claim for later releases.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

diagnostics.action: Check the exact Daedalus version before troubleshooting a missing governance control.

resolutions.action: Consult official release information and use an officially distributed supported release when governance functionality is required.
resolutions.why: Version 7.0.0 release notes establish the feature boundary.

expected_outcome.text: The user can identify the DRep delegation feature documented for Daedalus 7.0.0 without assuming later-version behavior.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, or spending passwords.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

evidence.rationale: Official release notes provide the introduction boundary.

faq.reason: Version-sensitive feature expectation likely to confuse users.
